description: The Claude Code and Codex accounts (named logins) skills run as: for each its state (ready, needs_login, expired, limited, missing_secret, disabled), who it is logged in as, its plan, its usage windows (5h, weekly, per model; with `usage: true` asked from each account's CLI now), its last use, its jobs of the last 24 hours, the skills that use it, and `attention`: what needs a person, each with the command that fixes it. With `mcp: true` (slow: every server connects) also `mcp`: the MCP servers, claude.ai / ChatGPT connectors and plugins each account's runs get, whether each connected, needs authentication or failed, and attention items for them. Logging in is done by a person in a terminal (`skillhook accounts login <name>`), never by a tool.
name: list_accounts
title: Accounts
